# Lifestyle Photography by Tiffany

> Family and lifestyle photographer based in Spring Lake, North Carolina, serving the Fayetteville and Fort Bragg area. Specializing in newborn, maternity, family, children, milestone, and cake smash photography with a natural, baby-led, lifestyle approach.

## About
- Photographer: Tiffany Jarosz
- Business: Lifestyle Photography by Tiffany (also known as Tiffany Jarosz Photography)
- Location: Spring Lake, NC 28390
- Service area: Spring Lake, Fayetteville, Fort Bragg, Sanford, Cameron, Raeford, and surrounding North Carolina areas
- Experience: 5+ years professional photography
- Style: Lifestyle and baby-led — capturing authentic, unposed moments rather than stiff studio portraits
- Military-family friendly: available for PCS-move, homecoming, deployment, and milestone sessions for Fort Bragg families

## Services and Pricing
- Themed Mini Sessions — $99 (15-20 minutes, 8 high-resolution digitally enhanced images, online gallery)
- Milestone — $200 (1 hour, 15 high-res images, online gallery)
- Cake Smash — $250 (up to 1 hour, 15 high-res images, cake included, online gallery)
- Maternity — $300 (1 hour, 20 high-res images, online gallery)
- Newborn — $350 (up to 1 hour baby-led session, 20 high-res images, online gallery)
- Family — $400 (1 hour, 25 high-res images, up to 6 people, online gallery)

## Good to Know
- All images are delivered via an online gallery
- Sessions are held on location (not in a studio)
- Travel included within 30 miles of Spring Lake, NC; additional travel available on request
- A 50% non-refundable retainer is required to book; remaining balance due on session day

## How to Book
- Contact form: https://photobytiff.com/contact
- Email: tiffany@photobytiff.com
- Typically responds within 24 hours
